text:
openapi: 3.1.1
info:
  title: Bank Customer API
  version: 0.1.0
  description: Customer-facing BFF contract. Browsers never call Fineract directly.
  license: { name: Apache-2.0, identifier: Apache-2.0 }
servers:
  - url: /api/customer/v1
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
paths:
  /customers/me:
    get:
      operationId: getCurrentCustomer
      summary: Get current customer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Current linked customer
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Customer' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
  /accounts:
    get:
      operationId: listAccounts
      summary: List customer accounts
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Accounts linked to the authenticated customer
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [items]
                properties:
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AccountSummary' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
  /accounts/{accountId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/AccountId'
    get:
      operationId: getAccount
      summary: Get customer account
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Account summary
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AccountSummary' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /loans/applications:
    post:
      operationId: createLoanApplication
      summary: Create loan application draft
      requestBody:

'401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403': { description: Source account is not owned by the customer }
  /loans/applications/{applicationId}/submit:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ApplicationId' }]
    post:
      operationId: submitLoanApplication
      summary: Submit loan application
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Submitted channel application
          content:
            application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/LoanApplication' } }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
  /loans/applications/{applicationId}/core-submit:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ApplicationId' }]
    post:
      operationId: submitLoanToCore
      summary: Submit loan application to Fineract
      parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey' }]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Core loan reference
          content:
            application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CoreLoanReference' } }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '409': { description: Application state conflict }
  /loans/applications/{applicationId}/core/{command}:
    parameters:
      - { $ref: '#/components/parameters/ApplicationId' }
      - name: command
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, enum: [approve, disburse, reject, withdrawByApplicant, undoapproval, undodisbursal] }
    post:
      operationId: commandCoreLoan
      summary: Execute core loan command
      parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey' }]
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json: { schema: { type: object, additionalProperties: true

} }
      responses:
        '200': { description: Core command result }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
  /loans/applications/{applicationId}/repayment:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ApplicationId' }]
    post:
      operationId: repayCoreLoan
      summary: Repay core loan
      parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey' }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RepaymentRequest' } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: Repayment result }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
  /loans/applications/{applicationId}/close:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ApplicationId' }]
    post:
      operationId: closeCoreLoan
      summary: Close core loan
      parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey' }]
      responses:
        '200': { description: Closed loan result }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth: { type: http, scheme: bearer, bearerFormat: JWT }
  parameters:
    AccountId:
      name: accountId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 64 }
    ApplicationId:
      name: applicationId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    IdempotencyKey:
      name: Idempotency-Key
      in: header
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, minLength: 8, maxLength: 128 }
  responses:
    Unauthorized:
      description: Authentication required
      content:
        application/problem+json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' } }
    NotFound:
      description: Resource
